cues.title: 四组对照，出现新结果
cues.titleEn: Four groups reveal a new result
cues.caption: 四组对照，留下转化问题。
cues.zh: 先比较四组历史实验。R型活菌不使小鼠死亡，S型活菌使小鼠死亡；热致死的S型单独也不使小鼠死亡。关键是第四组：把R型活菌与热致死的S型混合，结果又出现了死亡。仅凭这个结果，还不能说遗传物质就是DNA。
cues.en: Compare four historical groups. Live R bacteria did not kill the mice; live S did. Heat-killed S alone did not. The fourth group was decisive: live R mixed with heat-killed S again caused death. This result alone did not identify DNA as the genetic material.

cues.title: 分离活菌，再看后代
cues.titleEn: Recover live bacteria and examine descendants
cues.caption: 活S型的后代仍有S型性状。
cues.captionEn: Live S descendants retain the S trait.
cues.zh: 再看混合组后续的观察。从中分离到的不是只有死菌碎片，而是S型活菌；继续培养，它们的后代也具有S型性状。这支持有某种物质使R型发生可遗传的转化。热致死的S型并不是重新复活，转化因子的化学身份仍需检验。
cues.en: Examine what was recovered from the mixed group: live S bacteria, whose descendants retained S characteristics. This supported a heritable transformation of R cells by some material. Heat-killed S cells had not simply revived. The chemical identity of the transforming principle remained unresolved.

cues.title: 把问题转到培养物
cues.caption: 把转化活性带入可处理的提取物。
cues.captionEn: Test transforming activity in an extract.
cues.zh: 艾弗里等人先制备S型细胞提取物，去除绝大部分糖类、蛋白质和脂质，再加入有R型活菌的培养基。培养物中出现了S型。这一步把转化问题放到可处理的提取物上。图中的四类成分只是成分标识，不表示它们含量相等，也不是全部残留物的实测组成。
cues.en: Avery and colleagues prepared an S-cell extract after removing most sugars, proteins and lipids. Added to live R cultures, it produced S cells. The transforming activity could now be tested through the extract. Four component symbols identify candidates; they do not imply equal quantities or a measured composition.

cues.title: 逐一破坏，追问必要成分
cues.caption: 去除DNA后，原有转化活性消失。
cues.zh: 依次看四种处理。蛋白酶破坏蛋白质，RNA酶和酯酶各处理相应成分，转化活性仍在。换成DNA酶，DNA被破坏，培养物只出现R型。选择性处理必须有效，而且不能另行杀死受体。结合纯化和理化性质，这组证据把可遗传的转化与DNA联系起来。
cues.en: Follow four treatments in turn. Protease, RNase and lipase act on their respective components, yet transforming activity remains. DNase destroys DNA and the culture produces only R cells. Treatments must be selective and effective, without separately killing the recipients. Together with purification and chemical characterization, this links heritable transformation to DNA.

cues.title: 两批同位素，分别追踪
cues.caption: 分别标记两批，再感染未标记宿主。
cues.captionEn: Label two separate batches, then infect hosts.
cues.zh: 赫尔希和蔡斯把问题换成T2噬菌体。先在带同位素的培养条件下培养大肠杆菌，再让噬菌体在其中增殖。第一批用硫三十五追踪蛋白质外壳，第二批用磷三十二追踪DNA。随后两批分别感染未标记的大肠杆菌，不能把这一步画成噬菌体直接在无细胞培养基里繁殖。
cues.en: Hershey and Chase used phage T2. Labeled bacteria first supplied material for growing phage. One batch traced protein with sulfur thirty-five; the other traced DNA with phosphorus thirty-two. Each batch then infected unlabeled bacteria. Phages were grown through hosts, not directly in a cell-free nutrient medium.

cues.title: 跟住外壳与DNA
cues.caption: 沿主要路径，跟住原有来源。
cues.captionEn: Follow the source along the dominant route.
cues.zh: 放大噬菌体与细菌的接触处。先看带菱形标记的外壳，它仍在细胞外；再看圆形标记的DNA，它沿尾部进入宿主。这里重建的是实验支持的主要路径，不是当年直接拍摄的分子影片，也不意味着所有放射性都完全按这一条路径分离。
cues.en: Zoom into the phage–host interface. First follow the diamond on the coat, which stays outside. Then follow the circle on DNA as it passes through the tail. This reconstructs the dominant pathway supported by the experiments; it is not a molecular movie recorded at the time, nor a claim of perfectly pure separation.

cues.title: 先脱离，再分层检测
cues.caption: 先分开外壳，再检测各部分。
cues.captionEn: Detach coats, then assay the fractions.
cues.zh: 两批都经过搅拌，再离心。搅拌让吸附外壳与细菌分开，离心使细菌进入管底的沉淀。硫标记主要出现在上清液，磷标记主要在细菌沉淀中。注意两种颜色是追踪符号，实际要用仪器检测放射性。如果省略搅拌，外壳可随细菌一起沉淀，单凭沉淀中的信号就难以解释谁进入了细胞。
cues.en: Each batch is blended and centrifuged. Blending detaches adsorbed coats; centrifugation collects bacteria in the pellet. Sulfur is mainly detected in the supernatant, phosphorus mainly in the pellet. Colors are tracing symbols, not visible radioactive dyes. Without blending, attached coats can accompany the bacteria into the pellet, confounding the inference.

cues.title: 再问标记能否进入子代
cues.titleEn: Ask whether parental label reaches progeny
cues.caption: 比较进入子代的亲代放射性。
cues.zh: 最后检测子代中的亲代标记。原论文报告，进入子代的亲代硫放射性低于百分之一，亲代磷则为百分之三十或更多。这个分母是亲代总放射性，不是有标记的子代个数。证据支持DNA在T2遗传中的作用，但不能推出所有病毒都使用DNA；教材接着指出，有些病毒以RNA为遗传物质。
cues.en: Finally examine parental label recovered in progeny. The original paper reports less than one percent of parental sulfur radioactivity and thirty percent or more of parental phosphorus. The denominator is parental radioactivity, not a count of labeled offspring. This supports DNA’s hereditary role in T2, without implying that every virus has a DNA genome.

chapters.captionEn: Live R plus heat-killed S gives a different result from either alone.

chapters.captionEn: Live S bacteria recovered from the mixture produce S descendants.

chapters.captionEn: S-cell extract transforms some R cells in culture.

chapters.captionEn: Activity remains after protease, RNase or lipase, but is lost after DNase.

chapters.caption: 先通过带标记的宿主培养噬菌体，再感染未标记宿主。
chapters.captionEn: Grow labeled phage through labeled hosts, then infect unlabeled hosts.

chapters.caption: 主要路径是DNA经尾部进入宿主，蛋白质外壳留在外侧。
chapters.captionEn: The dominant path sends DNA through the tail while the coat remains outside.

chapters.captionEn: Blending detaches coats; centrifugation separates bacteria from the supernatant.

chapters.titleEn: Ask whether parental label reaches progeny

chapters.captionEn: Progeny evidence supports a hereditary role for DNA, with experimental qualifications.

label.zh: 格里菲思的肺炎链球菌转化实验
艾弗里鉴定转化因子的实验
label.en: Avery’s identification of the transforming principle

label.zh: 赫尔希和蔡斯的噬菌体侵染细菌实验
label.en: Hershey and Chase’s bacteriophage infection experiment

question.zh: 死亡结果，怎样变成可遗传转化的证据？
question.en: How does a lethal outcome become evidence for heritable transformation?

lead.zh: 比较四组感染结果，再看混合组回收到的活S型及其后代。
lead.en: Compare four infection groups, then inspect live S cells recovered from the mixed group and their descendants.

principle.zh: 感染结果与可遗传性是不同证据；仍须检验转化因子的化学身份。
principle.en: Infection outcomes and heritability are distinct evidence; the transforming material still requires chemical identification.

question.zh: 只看到混合组小鼠死亡，能立即认定DNA吗？
question.en: Does death in the mixed group alone identify DNA?

explanation.zh: 不能。回收并继续培养支持可遗传转化；化学成分需要下一组独立处理证据。
explanation.en: No. Recovery and subsequent culture support heritable transformation; chemical identity requires a separate treatment comparison.

question.zh: 去掉哪一种成分，转化活性会消失？
question.en: Removing which component removes transforming activity?

lead.zh: 对同源提取物分别处理，保留活受体作为观察转化的必要条件。
lead.en: Treat extracts from the same source separately and retain live recipients as a necessary assay condition.

principle.zh: 选择性破坏DNA后活性消失，与纯化及理化性质一起支持DNA的作用；不能把受体缺失当作提取物失活。
principle.en: Loss of activity after selective DNA destruction, together with purification and chemical evidence, supports DNA’s role; absence of recipients is not extract inactivation.

question.zh: 完整提取物里不放R型活受体，没有S型出现意味着什么？
question.en: What does no S growth mean if intact extract is tested without live R recipients?

explanation.zh: 不能据此判断转化因子失活，因为缺少接受转化并产生后代的细胞。
explanation.en: It cannot establish inactivation: recipient cells needed for transformation and progeny are absent.

question.zh: 沉淀里有标记，就说明它进入细胞了吗？
question.en: Does label in a pellet prove entry into the cell?

lead.zh: 两批分别标记；跟住外壳与DNA，再通过搅拌、离心和子代检测分开推断。
lead.en: Label independent batches; track coat and DNA, then separate inferences through blending, centrifugation and progeny assays.

principle.zh: 分离步骤决定信号能否区分外附与进入；亲代放射性比例不等于有标记子代的数量比例。
principle.en: Separation determines whether signal distinguishes attached from internal material; parental-radioactivity fractions are not fractions of labeled offspring.

question.zh: 省略搅拌后，外壳随细菌沉淀，还能只凭沉淀信号判定谁进入了吗？
question.en: If coats sediment with bacteria without blending, can the pellet alone identify what entered?

explanation.zh: 不能。外附外壳会混入同一部分，需要有效分离与其他独立证据；原实验也没有绝对纯净的两部分。
explanation.en: No. Attached coats confound that fraction. Effective separation and independent evidence are needed; the original fractions were not perfectly pure either.
